carrier: H0={psi in R^12: 1^T psi=0} with metric g_A(u,v)=u^T A v
connection: the translation-invariant Levi-Civita connection on the affine vector space H0
theorem: Because ker(A)=span(1), A induces a positive metric on the canonical mean-zero quotient H0. Its translation-invariant metric has a unique Levi-Civita connection, which is flat, torsion-free, and D12-invariant. Transporting this connection under nonlinear charts makes every covariant response tensor natural. In the explicit x=y+c y^6 test, the ordinary normalized response is g+6ac^2 while the twelfth covariant response is exactly g; the chart artifact cancels symbolically.
